note: Cross-zone only. 'edges' holds the closed-vocabulary relations (barrier_for, repair_of, supersedes) and is what scripts/build_semantic_corpus.py ingests. 'non_edges' holds the other half of this lens's mandate - the sibling engine, method or parameter family that a barrier demonstrably does NOT reach - under the relation name 'does_not_block'. That name is deliberately kept out of 'edges' because it is not in RELATIONS and scripts/check_semantic_corpus.py enforces the closed vocabulary; it is recorded here rather than left to the reader because a barrier whose unreached siblings are unrecorded is exactly the failure this layer exists to prevent. from_zone/to_zone follow relations_equivalence_reformulation.json and disambiguate the two node ids (lcm_cone_flatness_law, lcm_ray_window_structure) that occur in both Z01 and Z06.
